newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 2,060-2,120 per dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria lev ends softer at 2,060-2,120 per dollar.

text.p: The Bulgarian lev eased to 2,060-2,120 per dollar in light interbank volume at close from the morning's 2,000-2,080 due to a rise in dollar demand, dealers said.
"Demand rose in the afternoon due to increased short covering from banks and financial houses. Final clients also were bidding for small volumes," one dealer said.

Traders said the lev would probably trade range bound between 2,000-2,200 per dollar on Friday due to general reluctance to sell below 2,000 and to buy above 2,200. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
